artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is illegible smudges. While expected at this resolution, AI generators often fail to render coherent text structures even when simulating high-res screens. The layout looks plausible but the characters are nonsensical blobs.
The skin texture is overly smooth and waxy, lacking fine pores or wrinkles. The boundaries between fingers and the device show slight blending/melting, particularly where the thumb meets the casing.

The circular navigation pad lacks clear mechanical definition. The buttons seem to merge into the central circle without clear gaps or depth, looking more like a printed graphic than a physical 3D object.
Excessive blur around the device edges suggests a failure in edge definition or a simulated depth-of-field that bleeds into the subject slightly.
